fusions.name: Stoop at Speed
fusions.desc: A diving kick at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 10 damage, rising to 2 times that at full range, and knocks it 2.5 tiles back.

fusions.name: Beaten Air
fusions.desc: You beat the air down across a 4-tile cone, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour. Each hit has a 50% chance of [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hollow-Boned Sprint
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds. You bound 2 tiles from where you stood, with +10% dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Barely Touching Ground

riders.text: your hooves leave the ground sooner
and blows find only the air behind you
and your kicks land between strides

fusions.desc: Raises your Speed by 1, and your Speed ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you move 5% faster, from silver your dodge chance rises 5%, and from gold you attack 8% faster.
